equipment.name: 4pt Sheet Resistance
equipment.specifications: The co-linear four point probe system measures sheet resistance values from 0.1 milli-ohm per square up to 99 kilo-ohm per square. Thin films on samples less than 3” in diameter can be used with the system. Category: Thin Films.

equipment.name: Accent Hall Effect Measurement
equipment.specifications: The Accent hall effect tool is a turn-key system for measurement of resistivity, carrier concentration and mobility semiconductor materials. Samples can have Van der Pauw, bar, or bridge shaped geometries can all be used. Category: Electrical Testing.

equipment.name: Acid Wet Bench
equipment.specifications: The general purpose wet bench handles a majority of required aqueous chemistries within the cleanroom. Small pieces through 8” wafers can be accommodated using various provided PTFE holders. No solvents or heavy metals. Category: Etching.

equipment.name: AJA RF/DC Sputter Coater
equipment.specifications: The AJA Orion system is capable of both RF and DC based magnetron sputtering in a high vacuum turbo pumped chamber. Four targets are installed concurrently and can enable co-sputtering. 3” samples can be heated, via an IR lamp, up to 600C. No toxics. Category: Deposition.

equipment.name: Allied High Tech Polish/Grind/Lap
equipment.specifications: The Allied MultiPrep system enables precise semiautomatic sample preparation of a wide range of materials for microscopic evaluation. Capabilities include parallel polishing, angle polishing, site-specific polishing or any combination thereof. Samples up to 3” can be mounted onto the platen assembly and polished with diamond embedded film and/or slurries. Category: Ancillary.

equipment.name: Applied Materials P5000 PECVD
equipment.specifications: The Applied Materials P5000 has two dedicated chambers for dielectric PECVD. One utilizes a TEOS/O2 chemistry for silicon dioxide and the other is SiH4/NH3 capable for silicon nitrides. Both can process up to 8” wafers and deposit films multiple microns thick. Nominal operating temperature is ~400C. Category: Deposition.

equipment.name: Atomic Force Microscope
equipment.specifications: Digital Instruments Multimode IIIa Atomic Force Microscope (AFM) can obtain 3D surface topography at nanometer scale resolution, to measure contact and friction forces between surfaces. Category: Microscopy.

equipment.name: Auger Electron Spectroscopy
equipment.specifications: Provides detailed surface chemistry at the sub-10 nm scale. Operates by spectroscopy of Auger electrons generated by an ultra-fine scanning electron probe. Chemical information from regions as small as 10 nm with sensitivity of a few parts per thousand. Category: Spectroscopy.

equipment.name: Bruce Horizontal Furnace
equipment.specifications: High temperature, three tube, atmospheric, horizontal furnace. Accepts up to 5” wafers with maximum operating temperature of 1100C. Tube 1: CMOS compatible dry oxidations. Tube 2: dry oxidations, wet oxidation, inert anneals. Tube 3: solid source phosphorus doping. Category: Annealing.

equipment.name: Bruker Optical Profilometer
equipment.specifications: Non-contact method to study sample surface topography in three dimensions. Vertical resolution on the order of ten of nanometers with a trade off in field size. Category: Thin Films.

equipment.name: Carl Zeiss 1540EsB Crossbeam
equipment.specifications: FIB/SEM system with FESEM electron column (resolution approaching 2nm) and Ga ion column for milling. Can deposit Pt, W, and SiOx via GIS. GIS has 2 etch gases (XeF2 and H2O). Category: Microscopy.

equipment.name: Carl Zeiss Supra 55 FESEM
equipment.specifications: FESEM with Schottky thermal field emission source. Imaging resolution in the 2nm range. Multiple detectors for Secondary Imaging and Backscatter. Equipped with blanker and control system for electron beam lithography. Category: Microscopy.

equipment.name: Confocal Raman Microscope
equipment.specifications: WITec Alpha 300R Confocal Raman imaging system. Acquires chemical information non-destructively with ~200 nm resolution. Equipped with 532 nm green laser, max 17 mW power. Category: Spectroscopy.

equipment.name: CorSolutions Microfluidic Station
equipment.specifications: Probe station for non-permanent, compression connections to microfluidic devices. High precision, programmable pumps deliver constant controlled flows or biomimetic modulations. Includes microscope and video capture system. Category: Ancillary.

equipment.name: CVC DC Sputter Coater
equipment.specifications: Cryo pumped high vacuum system for PVD sputtering of conductive targets. Up to 8” substrates can be processed; four targets concurrently installed. Category: Deposition.

equipment.name: Dektak 6 Profilometer
equipment.specifications: Semi-manual contact profilometer capable of measuring vertical steps from tens of nanometers to 1mm in depth. Category: Thin Films.

equipment.name: Dektak 8 Profilometer
equipment.specifications: Contact profilometer capable of measuring vertical steps from tens of nanometers to 1mm in depth. Scan lengths up to 50mm on samples as large as 8” wafers. Category: Thin Films.

equipment.name: Denton Pt Sputter System
equipment.specifications: Tabletop sputter coater used for SEM sample preparation. Platinum target for depositing thin conductive film. Maximum sample size ~2”. Category: Sample Preparation.

equipment.name: Despatch Convection Oven
equipment.specifications: High uniformity convection oven used for resist post bakes. Operating temp typically 120C, capable up to ~200C. Atmospheric pressure in room air. Category: Annealing.

equipment.name: Developing Bench
equipment.specifications: Used to dissolve non-cross linked polymeric films (photoresist). Submersion based development for samples up to 8” in diameter. Aqueous hydroxide based develop solutions only. Category: Lithography.

equipment.name: Dual Beam SEM and FIB
equipment.specifications: VERSA 3D Dual Beam combining scanning electron microscopy (SEM) and Focused Ion Beam (FIB) in a single platform. Samples can be ion beam milled and platinum deposited. Secondary and backscattered electron imaging available. Category: Microscopy.

equipment.name: Edwards Thermal Evaporator
equipment.specifications: Cryo-pumped system for thin film deposition with two power sources capable of binary sequential or co-evaporative process. Category: Deposition.

equipment.name: Electrostatic manipulator
equipment.specifications: Electrostatic manipulator used to lift-out TEM samples and move micron sized flakes/particles into positions of interest. Category: Ancillary.

equipment.name: Filmetrics F40 Interferometer
equipment.specifications: Provides rapid thin film thickness and optical constants measurements on common device film stacks. 30um spot size, samples up to 8” wafers. Transparent films from ~50nm to tens of microns. Category: Thin Films.

equipment.name: FineTech Die Bonder
equipment.specifications: Fineplacer system multipurpose bonder with ~5um placement accuracy for flip chip bonding, die bonding, and micro-assembly. Category: Ancillary.

equipment.name: Flood UV Exposure / Ozone Clean
equipment.specifications: UV flood exposure system utilizing ozone and oxygen radical species to clean organics or modify surfaces. Samples up to 6” in diameter. Category: Etching.

equipment.name: Fourier Transform Infrared Spectroscopy
equipment.specifications: Perkin Elmer Spectrum One FT-IR Spectrometer operating in range 4000 - 350 cm-1 with 0.5 cm-1 resolution. Equipped with mid-range DTGS infrared detector. Category: Spectroscopy.

equipment.name: Headway Manual Spin Coater
equipment.specifications: Spin coats liquid materials, solutions, or suspensions. Spindle manually controlled up to 4” substrates. Category: Lithography.

equipment.name: Headway Spin Coater
equipment.specifications: Uses centrifugal force to coat fluids across substrate surface. Small pieces through 6” wafers. Programmable controller, speeds up to 8000RPM (typo in source: 800RPM). Category: Lithography.

equipment.name: Heatpulse Rapid Thermal Anneal
equipment.specifications: Radiation based RTA processing up to 4” wafers. Atmospheres: N2, Ar, O2. Temperature range: 300C to 1000C. Category: Annealing.

equipment.name: High Temp 1” Single Tube Furnace
equipment.specifications: High temperature convective tube furnace processing up to 0.5” samples. Atmospheres: Ar, O2. Temperature range: 500C to >1400C. Category: Annealing.

equipment.name: JA Woollam Ellipsometer
equipment.specifications: Non-contact measurement system for thickness and optical properties of thin films. Samples over 44 discrete wavelengths across white light spectrum. Measures films from ~1um to single nanometers. Category: Spectroscopy.

equipment.name: Jipelec Rapid Thermal Anneal
equipment.specifications: Radiation based RTA tool processing up to 6” wafers. Atmospheres: Ar, Ar/H2, ethylene. Temperature range: 300C to 1000C. Category: Annealing.

equipment.name: K&S Wire Ball Bonder
equipment.specifications: K&S 4524 Ball Bonder with digital controls for ultrasonically bonding gold wires from 18 - 75 micron. Category: Ancillary.

equipment.name: K&S Wire Wedge Bonder
equipment.specifications: Manual wedge wire bonder configured for gold or aluminum wire sizes from 0.7 to 3.0 mil. Includes heated work holder and stereo-zoom microscope. Category: Ancillary.

equipment.name: Keithley 4200 IV/CV Meter (1)
equipment.specifications: Modular and fully-integrated parameter analyzer for current-voltage and capacitance-voltage behavior analysis. Category: Electrical Testing.

equipment.name: Keithley 4200 IV/CV Meter (2)
equipment.specifications: Modular and fully-integrated parameter analyzer for current-voltage and capacitance-voltage behavior analysis. Category: Electrical Testing.

equipment.name: Lindbergh 2” Single Tube Furnace
equipment.specifications: Convective tube furnace processing up to 1.5” samples. Atmospheres: N2, Ar, O2. Temperature range: 500C to 1000C. Category: Annealing.

equipment.name: Lindbergh 3” Metal Furnace
equipment.specifications: Convective tube furnace processing up to 2.5” samples. Atmospheres: Ar, O2. Temperature range: 500C to >1200C. Category: Annealing.

equipment.name: Microtome
equipment.specifications: RMC Powertome XL microtome for sectioning specimens for electron microscopy. Thick/thin sectioning from 20-999 nm. Cryostage -120 °C to RT. Category: Sample Preparation.

equipment.name: MJB3 Contact Aligner
equipment.specifications: Broadband MUV contact lithography tool reproducing linewidths down to 1um on substrates up to 3 inch. Single field alignment microscope. Category: Lithography.

equipment.name: MPT Rapid Thermal Anneal
equipment.specifications: Radiation based RTA tool processing up to 4” wafers. Atmospheres: N2, O2. Temperature range: 300C to 1000C. Category: Annealing.

equipment.name: MTI LPCVD Furnace
equipment.specifications: LPCVD system configured for graphene growth. Supply gases: methane, argon, nitrogen, hydrogen. Base vacuum <100mT, max temp 1100C. Category: Deposition.

equipment.name: Nanoindenter
equipment.specifications: Hysitron TI900 Triboindenter automated high-throughput system for nanomechanical characterization. Category: Mechanical Testing.

equipment.name: Nikon Optical Microscope
equipment.specifications: Optical microscope with video capture capability. Brightfield and darkfield modes with 5x, 10x, 20x, 50x, and 100x magnification lenses. Category: Microscopy.

equipment.name: OAI Contact Aligner
equipment.specifications: Broadband mid-UV exposure tool for samples up to 8” wafers. Dual optic alignment system (~1um frontside overlay, ~20um backside overlay). Category: Lithography.

equipment.name: Ocean Optics Optical Spectrometer
equipment.specifications: USB4000-UV-VIS miniature spectrometer for UV-Vis measurements from 200-850 nm including absorption, transmission, reflectance, and emission. Category: Spectroscopy.

equipment.name: Olympus Optical Microscope
equipment.specifications: Optical white light microscope with objective magnifications of 5x, 20x, 50x, and 100x. Category: Microscopy.

equipment.name: Oxford Aztec EDS and EBSD System
equipment.specifications: Peltier cooled SDD x-ray detector (80mm2) with high count rate. High sensitivity EBSD camera with 4-channel fore scattering detector system. Category: Diffraction.

equipment.name: Oxford INCA EDS
equipment.specifications: 10mm2 detector with 140eV resolution for elemental analysis, mapping, line scans, and point/area analysis. Category: Spectroscopy.

equipment.name: Parylene Coater
equipment.specifications: Deposits conformal polymeric coating on exposed surfaces with thickness controlled from nanometers to multiple microns. Category: Deposition.

equipment.name: Photoresist Solvent Strip
equipment.specifications: Uses NMP based organic solvent to dissolve photoresists. Incompatible with copper and SU-8. Category: Lithography.

equipment.name: PicoSun Atomic Layer Deposition
equipment.specifications: Thermal and plasma enhanced ALD system accepting up to 8” wafers, max temp 400C. Configured for 5 precursor reagents and 3 plasma gases (N2, H2, O2). Category: Deposition.

equipment.name: PlasmaTherm PECVD
equipment.specifications: One chamber dedicated to PECVD processing (SiO2 at 300C, SiN at 250C). Accommodates samples up to 8” diameter. Category: Deposition.

equipment.name: PlasmaTherm RIE
equipment.specifications: One chamber dedicated to RIE processing using fluorinated chemistries (SF6, CHF3, CF4) for samples up to 8” diameter. Category: Etching.

equipment.name: PlasMod O2 Asher
equipment.specifications: Compact oxygen plasma asher processing up to 4” diameter samples for resist stripping, organic cleaning, and surface modification. Category: Etching.

equipment.name: RCA Wet Bench
equipment.specifications: Dedicated to CMOS compatible substrates up to 8” wafers for RCA chemistries. Category: Etching.

equipment.name: Rigaku XtaLAB SynergyS Dual Source Single Crystal Diffractometer
equipment.specifications: Single crystal diffractometer featuring rotating anode with dual wavelength (Mo and Cu), HyPix-6000HE Detector, and Oxford Cryosystems Cryostream 800 low temperature system (100K). Category: Diffraction.

equipment.name: SemiTool Spin Rinse Dry
equipment.specifications: Sprays DI water through dedicated rinse manifold and purges using heated N2. Accepts round wafers (3”, 4”, 6”, 8”). Category: Ancillary.

equipment.name: Solvent Fume Hood
equipment.specifications: General purpose solvent fume hood. Category: Ancillary.

equipment.name: Suss Manual 4 Probe Station
equipment.specifications: Electrical test of up to 8” wafers using 4 manual micromanipulators, heated stage, microscope video system, and test meters. Category: Electrical Testing.

equipment.name: Suss PSM6 Probe Manual Station
equipment.specifications: Electrical test of up to 6” wafers using 4 manual micromanipulators and heated stage, configured for use with Keithley 4200. Category: Electrical Testing.

equipment.name: Temescal e-Beam Evaporator (1)
equipment.specifications: Cryo-pumped high vacuum PVD thin film system (electron beam and thermal evaporation). Planetary accommodates up to 8” samples. Category: Deposition.

equipment.name: Temescal e-Beam Evaporator (2)
equipment.specifications: Cryo-pumped high vacuum PVD thin film electron beam evaporator. Planetary accommodates up to 8” samples. Category: Deposition.

equipment.name: Tencor Flexus Stress Measurement
equipment.specifications: Measures change in radius of curvature of wafer caused by thin film deposition to calculate stress and CTE. Wafers from 3” to 8”. Category: Thin Films.

equipment.name: Thermocarbo Dicing Saw
equipment.specifications: TCAR 864 diamond bladed programmable dicing saw for sample sizes up to 6” wafers. Category: Sample Preparation.

equipment.name: Tousimis Critical Point Dryer
equipment.specifications: Critical point dryer used to dry samples, reduce air drying damage, and release MEMS devices. Category: Sample Preparation.

equipment.name: Trion RIE
equipment.specifications: ICP-RIE system with fluorinated and chlorinated chemistries for semiconductor, compound semiconductor, and metal plasma etching. Category: Etching.

equipment.name: UV Spectrophotometer 1
equipment.specifications: Thermo Scientific Genesys 10 UV-Vis spectrophotometer operating from 325 – 1100 nm with 1.0 nm accuracy. Transmittance 0.3 to 125%, absorbance -0.1 to 3.0. Category: Spectroscopy.

equipment.name: UV Spectrophotometer 2
equipment.specifications: Perkin Elmer Lambda 950 UV-Vis-NIR spectrophotometer, wavelength range 175 – 3300 nm, resolution <0.05nm. Double beam, double monochromator, ratio recording with Photomultiplier R6872 detector. Category: Spectroscopy.

equipment.name: Vacuum Bake Oven
equipment.specifications: Small oven reaching ~150C at 22 inHg vacuum. Category: Annealing.

equipment.name: Veeco Dimension 3100 AFM
equipment.specifications: D-3100 AFM with large sub-stage for 6 inch wafers. Supports tapping, contact, CAFM, TUNA, MFM, wet cell imaging, and STM modes. Category: Microscopy.

equipment.name: X-Ray Photoelectron Spectroscope
equipment.specifications: XPS system for surface chemistry at sub-10 nm scale. Spatial resolution ~10 mm, spectral resolution <0.5 eV. Category: Spectroscopy.

equipment.name: YES Vacuum Oven
equipment.specifications: Convective vacuum oven accommodating up to 8” wafers, vacuum level ~500mT, temperature up to 170C. Category: Annealing.

equipment.name: Zeiss Supra Nabity E-beam
equipment.specifications: Zeiss SUPRA 55 FESEM equipped with Nabity control system for e-beam lithography. Reads CAD, DFX, GDSII formats; 20nm-50nm feature sizes. Category: Lithography.

equipment.name: Zyvex Nanoprobe System
equipment.specifications: 4 point probe system for near nano-scale test probing. Paired with Keithley Analyzers. Staff operated only. Category: Electrical Testing.

equipment.name: 4pt Sheet Resistance
equipment.specifications: The co-linear four point probe system measures sheet resistance values from 0.1 milli-ohm per square up to 99 kilo-ohm per square. Thin films on samples less than 3” in diameter can be used with the system.

equipment.name: Accent Hall Effect Measurement
equipment.specifications: The Accent hall effect tool is a turn-key system for measurement of resistivity, carrier concentration and mobility semiconductor materials. Samples can have Van der Pauw, bar, or bridge shaped geometries can all be used.

equipment.name: Acid Wet Bench
equipment.specifications: The general purpose wet bench handles a majority of required aqueous chemistries within the cleanroom. Small pieces through 8” wafers can be accommodated using various provided PTFE holders. No solvents or heavy metals.

equipment.name: AJA RF/DC Sputter Coater
equipment.specifications: The AJA Orion system is capable of both RF and DC based magnetron sputtering in a high vacuum turbo pumped chamber. Four targets are installed concurrently and can enable co-sputtering. 3” samples can be heated, via an IR lamp, up to 600C. No toxics.

equipment.name: Allied High Tech Polish/Grind/Lap
equipment.specifications: The Allied MultiPrep system enables precise semiautomatic sample preparation of a wide range of materials for microscopic (optical, SEM, FIB, TEM, AFM, etc.) evaluation. Capabilities include parallel polishing, angle polishing, site-specific polishing or any combination thereof. Samples up to 3” can be mounted onto the platen assembly and polished with diamond embedded film and/or slurries. No toxics.

equipment.name: Applied Materials P5000 PECVD
equipment.specifications: The Applied Materials P5000 has two dedicated chambers for dielectric PECVD. One utilizes a TEOS/O2 chemistry for silicon dioxide and the other is SiH4/NH3 capable for silicon nitrides. Both can process up to 8” wafers and deposit films multiple microns thick. Nominal operating temperature is ~400C. No volatiles, toxics, glass or metals without staff permission.

equipment.name: Atomic Force Microscope
equipment.specifications: Digital Instruments Multimode IIIa Atomic Force Microscope (AFM) can obtain 3D surface topography at nanometer scale resolution, to measure contact and friction forces between surfaces. Modes of Operation: Contact (regular, lateral, and current imaging) mode imaging, Tapping (regular, electric, and magnetic), Fluid cell. Available scanners: J-type, 125 um x 125 um, z 4.33 um; E-type, 10 um x 10 um, z 1.6 um.

equipment.name: Auger Electron Spectroscopy
equipment.specifications: The AES system provides detailed surface chemistry at the sub-10 nm scale. It operates by spectroscopy of Auger electrons (a multi-electron emission process) that are generated by an ultra-fine scanning electron probe. Chemical information from regions as small as 10 nm may be obtained, with chemical sensitivity of a few parts per thousand. The Auger signal is obtained from regions within about 1 nm of the surface, and an integrated ion sputtering enables the surface to be continuously removed, so that chemical depth profiles can be obtained.

equipment.name: Bruce Horizontal Furnace
equipment.specifications: The Bruce is a high temperature, three tube, atmospheric, horizontal furnace. It can accept up to 5” wafers and has a maximum operating temperature of 1100C. Tube 1 is dedicated to CMOS compatible dry oxidations. Tube 2 is capable of dry oxidations, wet oxidation and inert anneals. Tube 3 is used for solid source phosphorus doping. No volatiles or glass in any tube. CMOS compatible materials only in tube 1. Metals in tube 2 and tube 3 require staff permission.

equipment.name: Bruker Optical Profilometer
equipment.specifications: The optical profilometer is a non-contact method to study sample surface topography in three dimensions. Vertical resolution can be on the order of ten of nanometers with a trade off in field size. Samples of all sizes can typically be accommodated.

equipment.name: Carl Zeiss 1540EsB Crossbeam
equipment.specifications: The Zeiss 1540EsB Crossbeam is a FIB/SEM system. It has a FESEM electron column which has excellent imaging performance with resolution approaching the 2nm range. It also has a Ga ion column which allows for milling (sputtering) of materials from the sample. The system can also deposit Pt, W, and SiOx from precursors installed in the Gas Injection System. The GIS also has 2 etch gases including XeF2 and H2O. There are multiple detector options for different imaging modes.

equipment.name: Carl Zeiss Supra 55 FESEM
equipment.specifications: The Zeiss SUPRA 55 is a FESEM with a Schottky thermal field emission source. It has an ultimate imaging resolution in the range of 2nm. The SUPRA has multiple detectors for Secondary Imaging as well as Backscatter. The system has been setup with a blanker and a control system that can be used for doing electron beam lithography.

equipment.name: Confocal Raman Microscope
equipment.specifications: WITec Alpha 300R Confocal Raman imaging system has the ability to acquire chemical information non-destructively with a high resolution (~ 200 nm). The system is equipped with 532 nm green laser, max. 17 mW power.

equipment.name: CorSolutions Microfluidic Station
equipment.specifications: This probe station makes quick, non-permanent, compression connections to microfluidic devices. High precision, programmable pumps can deliver minute constant controlled flows or flows with biomimetic modulations. A microscope and video capture system can document flow parameters and visualizations. No solvents.

equipment.name: CVC DC Sputter Coater
equipment.specifications: The CVC is a cryo pumped high vacuum system for PVD sputtering of conductive targets. Up to 8” substrates can be processed and four targets are concurrently installed for use serially. No toxics.

equipment.name: Dektak 6 Profilometer
equipment.specifications: The Dektak 6 is a semi-manual contact profilometer capable of measuring vertical steps from tens of nanometers to 1mm in depth.

equipment.name: Dektak 8 Profilometer
equipment.specifications: The Dektak 8 is a contact profilometer capable of measuring vertical steps from tens of nanometers to 1mm in depth. Scan lengths of up to 50mm can be used on samples as large as 8” wafers.

equipment.name: Denton Pt Sputter System
equipment.specifications: The Denton is a tabletop sputter coater most commonly used for SEM sample preparation. It is equipped with a platinum target for depositing a very thin conductive film on the sample surface. Maximum sample size is approximately 2”.

equipment.name: Despatch Convection Oven
equipment.specifications: The Despatch is a high uniformity convection oven commonly used for resist post bakes. The oven is typically kept at 120C but has the ability to achieve ~200C. All baking is at atmospheric pressure in room air.

equipment.name: Developing Bench
equipment.specifications: The develop bench is used as part of the lithography process to dissolve away non-cross linked polymeric films (photoresist). Submersion based development can be accommodated for samples up to 8” in diameter. Aqueous hydroxide based develop solutions only.

equipment.name: Dual Beam SEM and FIB
equipment.specifications: The VERSA 3D Dual Beam combines scanning electron microscopy (SEM) and Focused Ion Beam (FIB) in a single platform that allows switching between two modes of operation. The samples can be milled via ion beam and deposited with platinum while observing the process. The milling and deposition processes can be performed on pre-adjusted patterns as well as externally provided patterns. In addition to secondary electron imaging, backscattered electron imaging is available where the two images can be combined to observe the contribution of each.

equipment.name: Edwards Thermal Evaporator
equipment.specifications: The Edwards thermal evaporator is a cryo-pumped system for depositing thin films. It is currently configured with two power sources capable of performing a binary sequential or co-evaporative process. No toxics.

equipment.name: Electrostatic manipulator
equipment.specifications: Electrostatic manipulator can be used to lift-out TEM samples as well as lift and move micron sized flakes and particles into positions of interest.

equipment.name: Filmetrics F40 Interferometer
equipment.specifications: The Filmetrics F40 interferometer provides users with rapid thin film thickness and optical constants measurements on most common device film stacks. A 30um spot size can be placed on patterned samples, from pieces up to 8” wafers. Transparent films from ~50nm to tens of microns can be measured.

equipment.name: FineTech Die Bonder
equipment.specifications: The Fineplacer system is a multipurpose bonder which offers ~5um placement accuracy. This versatile platform is used for various applications such a flip chip bonding, die bonding and micro-assembly.

equipment.name: Flood UV Exposure / Ozone Clean
equipment.specifications: The UV flood exposure system is a fast and easy way to utilize ozone and oxygen radicals species to clean organics from a sample surface. The system can also be used as a surface modifier for oxidation and terminal bonds. Samples up to 6” in diameter can be processed in the machine.

equipment.name: Fourier Transform Infrared Spectroscopy
equipment.specifications: The Perkin Elmer Spectrum One FT-IR Spectrometer works in a range of 4000 - 350 cm-1 with a 0.5 cm-1 resolution and equipped with a mid-range Deuterated triglycine sulfate (DTGS) infrared detector.

equipment.name: Headway Manual Spin Coater
equipment.specifications: This Headway system is used is spin coat liquid materials, solutions or suspensions. The spindle is controlled manually using the installed rotational tachometer. Up to 4” substrates can be processed.

equipment.name: Headway Spin Coater
equipment.specifications: The Headway spin coater uses centrifugal force to uniformly coat fluids across a substrate surface. Small pieces through 6” wafers can be processed through the coater with the correct corresponding spin chuck. The programmable controller can handle multistep recipes with spin spins up to 800RPM. All photoresist materials and/or staff approved materials only.

equipment.name: Heatpulse Rapid Thermal Anneal
equipment.specifications: The Heatpulse RTA is a radiation based rapid thermalization tool capable of processing up to 4” wafers. Offered atmospheric gas ambients include N2, Ar and O2. Controlled temperature capability runs from 300C to 1000C with exposure durations on the scale of minutes. No volatiles, toxics, or glass without staff permission.

equipment.name: High Temp 1” Single Tube Furnace
equipment.specifications: The anneal system is a high temperature convective tube furnace capable of processing up to 0.5” samples. Offered atmospheric gas ambients include Ar and O2. Controlled temperature capability runs from 500C to over 1400C with exposure durations on the scale of hours.

equipment.name: JA Woollam Ellipsometer
equipment.specifications: The ellipsomster is non-contact measurement system for measuring the thickness and optical properties of thin films. Our system samples over 44 discrete wavelengths, over the white light spectrum, and can incorporate varied incident angles as well. Films from ~1um down to single nanometers can be measured with accuracy and repeatability.

equipment.name: Jipelec Rapid Thermal Anneal
equipment.specifications: The Jipelec RTA is a radiation based rapid thermalization tool capable of processing up to 6” wafers. Offered atmospheric gas ambients include Ar, Ar/H2 and ethylene. Controlled temperature capability runs from 300C to 1000C with exposure durations on the scale of minutes. No volatiles, toxics, or glass without staff permission.

equipment.name: K&S Wire Ball Bonder
equipment.specifications: The K&S 4524 Ball Bonder with digital controls is an advanced bench-top gold ball bonder capable of ultrasonically bonding gold wires from 18 - 75 micron.

equipment.name: K&S Wire Wedge Bonder
equipment.specifications: The manual wedge wire bonder offers the versatility to bond simple discrete devices up to complex hybrid, microwave devices. Individual bond parameter and loop height control. Consistent tail length. Can be configured for gold or aluminum wire sizes from 0.7 to 3.0 mil. Includes heated work holder and stereo-zoom microscope.

equipment.name: Keithley 4200 IV/CV Meter (1)
equipment.specifications: The Keithley 4200 is a modular and fully-integrated parameter analyzer that provides analysis into current-voltage and capacitance-voltage behavior.

equipment.name: Keithley 4200 IV/CV Meter (2)
equipment.specifications: The Keithley 4200 is a modular and fully-integrated parameter analyzer that provides analysis into current-voltage and capacitance-voltage behavior.

equipment.name: Lindbergh 2” Single Tube Furnace
equipment.specifications: The Lindberg system is a high temperature convective tube furnace capable of processing up to 1.5” samples. Offered atmospheric gas ambients include N2, Ar, and O2. Controlled temperature capability runs from 500C to 1000C with exposure durations on the scale of hours.

equipment.name: Lindbergh 3” Metal Furnace
equipment.specifications: The Lindberg system is a high temperature convective tube furnace capable of processing up to 2.5” samples. Offered atmospheric gas ambients include Ar and O2. Controlled temperature capability runs from 500C to over 1200C with exposure durations on the scale of hours. No volatiles, toxics, or glass without staff permission. Metals below melting point are permitted.

equipment.name: Microtome
equipment.specifications: RMC Powertome XL microtome is used for the preparation of thin sections of specimens for electron microscopy. Thick/thin sectioning ranges from 20-999 nm. Cryostage compartment with a temperature control from -120 °C to room temperature.

equipment.name: MJB3 Contact Aligner
equipment.specifications: The MBJ3 is broadband MUV contact lithography tool capable of reproducing linewidths down to 1um. Diverse substrate types and sizes (up to 3 inch) can be accommodated. There is a single field alignment microscope allowing for overlay tolerances of several microns.

equipment.name: MPT Rapid Thermal Anneal
equipment.specifications: The MPT RTA is a radiation based rapid thermalization tool capable of processing up to 4” wafers. Offered atmospheric gas ambients include N2 and O2. Controlled temperature capability runs from 300C to 1000C with exposure durations on the scale of minutes. No volatiles, toxics, or glass without staff permission.

equipment.name: MTI LPCVD Furnace
equipment.specifications: The MTI is an LPCVD system configured for graphene growth. Supply gases include methane, argon, nitrogen and hydrogen. Base vacuum is below 100mT and maximum operating temperature is 1100C.

equipment.name: Nanoindenter
equipment.specifications: The Hysitron TI900 Triboindenter is an automated, high-throughput system for a complete nanomechanical characterization.

equipment.name: Nikon Optical Microscope
equipment.specifications: Optical microscope with video capture capability. Brightfield and darkfield observation modes can be used in conjunction with magnification lenses of 5x, 10x, 20x, 50x and 100x.

equipment.name: OAI Contact Aligner
equipment.specifications: The OAI contact aligner is broadband mid-UV exposure tool. It can expose samples ranging in size from small pieces up to 8” wafers. It has a dual optic alignment system capable of ~1um in mask to frontside overlay and ~20um in backside to frontside sample overlay. Image size reproducibility is limited to 1um.

equipment.name: Ocean Optics Optical Spectrometer
equipment.specifications: The USB4000-UV-VIS is a miniature spectrometer preconfigured for general UV-Vis measurements from 200-850 nm including absorption, transmission, reflectance and emission.

equipment.name: Olympus Optical Microscope
equipment.specifications: Optical white light microscope with objective magnifications of 5x, 20x, 50x, and 100x.

equipment.name: Oxford Aztec EDS and EBSD System
equipment.specifications: The Oxford AZTEC system is fitted out with a state of the art peltier cooled SDD x-ray detector. It has high count rate capabilities with an 80mm2 detector. The system also has a high sensitivity EBSD camera for doing Electron Backscattered Defraction imaging and mapping. The EBSD camera is mounted with a 4 channel fore scattering detector system for enhanced imaging and data acquisition. The system can do spectral analysis, mapping, linescans and point/area analysis. All the data can be exported to Word, or taken as raw data in the form of EMSA file.

equipment.name: Oxford INCA EDS
equipment.specifications: The Oxford INCA system has a 10mm2 detector with 140eV resolution. The system can do basic elemental analysis as well as mapping, line scans and point/ area analysis off of an image. All the data can be exported to Word, or taken as raw data in the form of EMSA file.

equipment.name: Parylene Coater
equipment.specifications: The parlyene system deposits a highly conformal polymeric coating on any exposed sample surfaces. The film thickness can be controlled from a few nanometers to multiple microns. It’s commonly used as a vapor/permeation barrier and hydrophobic coating. It is also well known for being biologically inert.

equipment.name: Photoresist Solvent Strip
equipment.specifications: The photoresist strip bench uses an NMP based organic solvent to dissolve most crosslinked and non-crosslinked photoresists. Incompatible with copper and not effective on SU-8.

equipment.name: PicoSun Atomic Layer Deposition
equipment.specifications: The PicoSun ALD system is capable of running in both thermal and plasma enhanced mode. The sample holder can accept up to 8” wafers and has a maximum operating temperature of 400C although many processes are enabled at significantly lower temps. It’s configured for up to five precursor reagents and 3 plasma gases (N2, H2, and O2). Maximum film thicknesses are typically less than 0.5um. No volatiles or toxics allowed.

equipment.name: PlasmaTherm PECVD
equipment.specifications: The PlasmTherm system has one chamber dedicated to PECVD processing. Standard recipes include silicon dioxide and silicon nitride depositions at a nominal operating temperature of 300C and 250C respectively. The chamber can accommodate samples up to 8” in diameter. Maximum film thickness top out at about 1um. No volatiles or toxics allowed.

equipment.name: PlasmaTherm RIE
equipment.specifications: The PlasmTherm system has one chamber dedicated to RIE processing. Standard recipes are supplied for semiconductor material etching using fluorinated chemistries including SF6, CHF3, and CF4. The chamber can accommodate samples up to 8” in diameter. No toxics.

equipment.name: PlasMod O2 Asher
equipment.specifications: The PlasMod is a compact oxygen plasma asher capable of processing up to 4” diameter samples. A direct oxygen based RF plasma is used for multiple applications ranging from photoresist stripping, organic cleaning, and surface modification.

equipment.name: RCA Wet Bench
equipment.specifications: The RCA wet bench is dedicated to CMOS compatible substrates only. It is capable of up to 8” wafer processing and is solely used in conjunction with RCA chemistries. CMOS-compatible samples only.

equipment.name: Rigaku XtaLAB SynergyS Dual Source Single Crystal Diffractometer
equipment.specifications: Rigaku's XtaLAB SynergyS Dual Source Single Crystal Diffractometer is a top-of-the-line instrument and features powerful X-ray beam from rotating anode with dual wavelength (Mo and Cu) coupled with Rigaku’s HyPix-6000HE Detector allowing extremely low noise, essentially zero deadtime and true shutterless data collection. It is also possible to collect data at 100K using the Oxford Cryosystems Cryostream 800 low temperature system. Data integration is carried out using CrysAlisPro.

equipment.name: SemiTool Spin Rinse Dry
equipment.specifications: The Spin Rinse Dryer sprays DI water through a dedicated rinse manifold. Water is then purged from the process chamber using heated N2. The system can only accommodate round wafers at fixed Semi standards (3”, 4”, 6” and 8”).

equipment.name: Solvent Fume Hood
equipment.specifications: General purpose solvent fume hood.

equipment.name: Suss Manual 4 Probe Station
equipment.specifications: The Suss probe station allows electrical test of up to 8” wafers using 4 manual micromanipulators. The test station is also equipped with a heated stage, microscope video system, and an array of electrical test meters.

equipment.name: Suss PSM6 Probe Manual Station
equipment.specifications: The Suss probe station allows electrical test of up to 6” wafers using 4 manual micromanipulators. The test station is also equipped with a heated stage and set up to be used in conjunction with the Keithley 4200 parametric analyzer.

equipment.name: Temescal e-Beam Evaporator (1)
equipment.specifications: The Tesmescal is a cryo-pumped high vacuum system for PVD thin films. Most commonly used as an electron beam technique it is also capable of thermal evaporations for some materials. Users must provide their own source materials and crucible, if required. The planetary can accommodate up to 8” samples. No toxics or copper.

equipment.name: Temescal e-Beam Evaporator (2)
equipment.specifications: The Tesmescal is a cryo-pumped high vacuum system for PVD thin films by electron beam evaporation. Users must provide their own source materials and crucible, if required. The planetary can accommodate up to 8” samples. No toxics or gold.

equipment.name: Tencor Flexus Stress Measurement
equipment.specifications: The Flexus us a stress measurement instrument that measures the change in the radius of curvature of a wafer caused by the deposition of a thin film. Given the properties of the substrate the software can then calculate the stress of the applied film and the thermal coefficient of expansion. Wafers from 3” to 8” can be analyzed. No volatiles if heated.

equipment.name: Thermocarbo Dicing Saw
equipment.specifications: The TCAR 864 is a diamond bladed programmable dicing saw. It’s capable of cutting into, or through, multiple types of substrates with industry leading precision. The machine can handle sample sizes ranging from pieces up to 6” wafers. No toxics.

equipment.name: Tousimis Critical Point Dryer
equipment.specifications: The Tousimis CPD is used to dry samples and reduce the damage introduced through “air” drying. It can also be used for releasing MEMS devices after their final etch. Staff guidance required.

equipment.name: Trion RIE
equipment.specifications: The Trion is an ICP-RIE system with both fluorinated and chlorinated chemistries. The system has recipes for semiconductor, compound semiconductor, and metal plasma etching. The ICP option allows for quasi-independent control of plasma density and ion bombardment energy reducing physical damage while retaining high etch rates and selectively. No toxics.

equipment.name: UV Spectrophotometer 1
equipment.specifications: The Thermo Scientific Genesys 10 UV-Vis spectrophotometer operates in single wavelength mode with a range of 325 – 1100 nm with 1.0 nm accuracy. The instrument has a photometric range of 0.3 to 125% transmittance and -0.1 to 3.0 absorbance. Six-cell position models accommodate 10-mm square cuvettes or 10-mm, 1/2" dia test tubes.

equipment.name: UV Spectrophotometer 2
equipment.specifications: The Perkin Elmer Lambda 950 UV-Vis-NIR spectrophotometer displays ultra-high UV/Vis/NIR performance for wavelengths up to 3300 nm, high precision measurements, and for applications such as highly reflective and anti-reflective coatings, color correction coatings. Its wavelength range is 175 – 3300 nm with less than 0.05nm resolution. It is a double beam, double monochromator, ratio recording UV/Vis/NIR spectrophotometer with microcomputer electronics. The detector is a Photomultiplier R6872 for high energy in the whole UV/Vis wavelength range.

equipment.name: Vacuum Bake Oven
equipment.specifications: This small oven can reach temperature of ~150C while maintaining a vacuum of 22 inHg.

equipment.name: Veeco Dimension 3100 AFM
equipment.specifications: The D-3100 has a large sub-stage which can handle 6 inch wafers. It has the ability to do tapping and contact modes. The system has other modules for doing CAFM, TUNA, MFM, Wet cell images, and STM. The results of each of these modules are based on the proper imaging conditions being met and having proper control samples to verify system performance.

equipment.name: X-Ray Photoelectron Spectroscope
equipment.specifications: The XPS system provides detailed surface chemistry at the sub-10 nm scale. It operates by spectroscopy of photo-electrons emitted from the sample surface by incident X-Ray or ultra-violet photons. These photoelectron energies provide highly sensitive information on chemical species and bonding in the sample surface region. The spatial resolution of this technique is about 10 mm, with a spectral resolution of < 0.5 eV.

equipment.name: YES Vacuum Oven
equipment.specifications: The YES oven can accommodate up to 8” wafers and pulls a vacuum level down to ~500mT. The convective heater can maintain a chamber temperature up to 170C.

equipment.name: Zeiss Supra Nabity E-beam
equipment.specifications: The Zeiss SUPRA 55 is a FESEM with a Schottky thermal field emission source. It has an ultimate imaging resolution in the range of 2nm. The SUPRA has multiple detectors for Secondary Imaging as well as Backscatter. The system has been setup with a blanker and a control system that can be used for doing electron beam lithography. The Nabity system is able to read standard CAD files, DFX, and GDSII formats. In e-beam lithography mode 20nm-50nm feature sizes are attainable.

equipment.name: Zyvex Nanoprobe System
equipment.specifications: A 4 point probe system for doing test probing on a near nano-scale. It can be paired with one of the center’s Keithley Analyzers for electrical characterization. This system is staff operated only.

analysis.summary: All 76 historical equipment items are preserved in the current inventory. Item specifications have been updated with standardized category tags, and minor corrections were made to tool parameters.

modified.name: Headway Spin Coater
modified.change: Corrected maximum spin speed from 800RPM to 8000RPM and added category tag.
